workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects only after ordered Runtime reconciliation granted Reading execution authority and the Worker Claimed event was durably verified. Q-20260815-01 verified two distinct ADK recovery trust boundaries: session initialization now rejects client-supplied long-running-tool markers, non-default runtime actions and ADK-reserved HITL protocol calls before session creation while intentionally admitting ordinary text/tool history; later confirmation resolution requires the ADK confirmation function name and binds the confirmation to an existing same-agent, registered, confirmation-requiring historical tool call with matching ID, name and arguments. Q-20260815-02 verified native RemoteA2aAgent task mode: coordinator FunctionCall identity becomes the isolation scope, Runner uses two-pass terminal-scope recovery, remote history is scoped to the delegation, output-schema-valid finish_task responses are semantic completion, and FAILED/CANCELED/transport failures map to failed terminal semantics before control returns to the parent. Q-20260815-03 verified live background-tool lifecycle ownership: streaming and non-blocking asyncio tasks are cancelled before handoff and in run_live teardown, cancellation is bounded to one second and explicitly best effort, task exceptions are observed, and stale stream/task registries are retired even when cancellation is ignored. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime Reconciliation 授予 Reading 执行权并持久核验 Worker Claimed 之后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260815-01 核验了 ADK 恢复过程中的两个独立信任边界：Session Initialization 在创建 Session 之前拒绝客户端提供的 Long-running Tool Marker、非默认 Runtime Action 与 ADK 保留 HITL Protocol Call，同时明确允许普通 Text / Tool History；后续 Confirmation Resolution 则要求使用 ADK Confirmation Function Name，并把确认绑定到历史中真实存在、由同一 Agent 负责、Tool 已注册且确实需要 Confirmation、且 ID / Name / Arguments 一致的原始 Tool Call。Q-20260815-02 核验了 RemoteA2aAgent 原生 Task Mode：Coordinator FunctionCall Identity 成为 Isolation Scope，Runner 通过两阶段 Terminal-scope Recovery 恢复活动任务，Remote History 被限制在本次委派范围，Output Schema 校验通过的 finish_task Response 构成语义完成，而 FAILED / CANCELED / Transport Failure 会映射成失败终态后再把控制权交还 Parent。Q-20260815-03 核验了 Live Background Tool 的生命周期所有权：Streaming 与 Non-blocking asyncio Task 会在 Handoff 之前以及 run_live 收尾时被取消，取消等待上限为 1 秒且明确属于 Best-effort；已结束 Task 的异常会被读取记录；即使 Task 忽略取消，陈旧 Stream / Task Registry 仍会退出当前 Run 的所有权。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
